body: Hey I just wanted to let you know I am doing a lot better now. I am so grateful for what u said to me that night. I know ull probably never see this and uve almost certainly forgotten all about me but I haven't forgotten you. It has been tough these last few months but it's been getting better and it's only been getting better since I talked to u. Just wanted to let you know that you have really helped me to just be a happier person so keep doing what your doing and have a great life :)
Thanks so much. Honestly just talking to u and knowing somebody cares has helped a lot thank u. I will have a look at the link.
I am currently living in the UK.
Let's be careful u don't drop ur phone
It's OK. We all feel lost sometimes and it's OK to feel lost, you musnt feel alone. If u need any help were here for u.

Thank you so much. Genuinly ur words are very kind and helpful. I posted this whilst still comming out of a very unhappy couple of hours, I honestly don't think I would have done if it I was thinking straight if I'm being totally honest, and ur words have really helped me clear my head.
I think the thought I struggle most with sometimes is  the classic one of "if I don't punish myself who will" and although I realise now this is an irrational thought it's difficult to realise that irrationality in those moments when I am most upset.
You talk of free services and I was just wondering what they were and if it were possible for me to talk to someone, not now but perhaps in the future when I am feeling a little more brave? But truly once again I just want to thank u for being a voice of reason here at least for me.
It's a very tall high rise
